newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were weaker with the exception of the April contract in after-hours trade on Monday, pressured by easier overseas markets, traders said.
Rubber prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kg lower to 0.3 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark June was off 0.3 yen at 143.7 yen. Volume was 4,981 lots.
During the day, the spot January contract expired at noon at 141.2 yen, with 495 lots of deliveries.
"Although the spot January expired higher as expected, weaker overseas markets, amid a lack of buying interest, are undermining market sentiment here," one trader said.
